title: Heat–Health Action Plans and urban vulnerability
discussion_signal: WHO connects rising temperatures, urbanization, and demographic ageing to unequal heat exposure and vulnerability. It presents heat-health plans, warning systems, resilient buildings, urban greening, and protection for vulnerable groups as coordinated public-health infrastructure.
linked_research_question: How do climate exposure, ageing, urban form, and public-health capacity combine to produce unequal heat risk?
limits: No city-level implementation evidence is presented
The post does not estimate which interventions reduce mortality most
